## UndergroundTriggersFile

UndergroundTriggersFile defines the trigger volumes used to manage underground
lighting transitions and ambient audio for the mission.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 1 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### UndergroundTriggersFile.Triggers

Key: `Triggers`

Triggers are the world-space volumes and transition points placed on the map. A
trigger with breadcrumbs performs a gradual transition; without them, its
eye-accommodation target determines whether it is an outer or inner area.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`UndergroundTrigger`](#undergroundtrigger) (`#/$defs/UndergroundTrigger`) |

## UndergroundTrigger

Path: [`Triggers`](#undergroundtriggersfiletriggers).`[]`.`EyeAccommodation`
